channel.description: Latest articles from The Valley Times-News (valleytimes-news.com)

item.title: RIVALRY GETS DEEPER: LaFayette, Lanett to meet in Elite Eight
item.description: For the fourth time this season, cross-county area rivals LaFayette and Lanett will be facing off on the basketball court. This time, a Final Four spot is on the line, with the teams slated to meet in the Elite Eight Round on Monday at Alabama State’s Dunn-Oliver Acadome in Montgomery.

item.title: Valley caps off successful basketball seasons
item.description: Valley boys and girls basketball both went unbeaten in area play, with the Lady Rams reaching the Sweet Sixteen and a young core set to return after standout seasons.

item.title: Junior Variety Club organizes bake auction
item.description: Junior Variety Club to hold March 22 Facebook bake auction to fund its Be The Light scholarship honoring late educator Amy Burton; community bakers invited to donate.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - John Tures: Does Requiring Voter ID On Election Day Create A Partisan Advantage?
item.description: John Tures and students study how voter ID rules align with 2024 Trump vote shares and review evidence that illegal voting is rare compared with the risks and burdens of SAVE Act requirements.

item.title: West Point Black History Program set for Tuesday
item.description: West Point's Feb. 24 Black History program at West Point Gym will feature $1 Thursday founder Anthony Talley and local school leaders, starting at 5:30 p.m.

item.title: CONTRIBUTOR'S VIEW - L. Michelle Moore: Doing Well by Doing Good meets the MAHA Movement
item.description: L. Michelle Moore connects GreenBiz sustainability leaders, MAHA moms and the PFAS crisis in Dalton, Georgia, showing how corporate choices and policy rollbacks shape public health.

item.title: Binance Casino: A Complete 2026 Guide
item.description: The rise of cryptocurrency gambling has introduced new concepts to online gaming, and the term Binance casino is increasingly searched by players worldwide.

item.title: Maintaining Visual Consistency Without an In-House Illustrator
item.description: Growing teams face a difficult question: how do you maintain a strict visual language without the overhead of building a proprietary icon set?

item.title: Valley Community Outreach hosts successful food drive
item.description: Valley Community Outreach, now in its sixth year, hosts a Valley Sportsplex food drive.

item.title: West Point discusses major redevelopment efforts
item.description: West Point officials outline redevelopment priorities, from assembling 10th Street land for major projects to advancing design for a Marriott hotel at the former Coca-Cola site.
